phase: Replicated development comparison; source and settings frozen before generation. Fresh confirmation after selection is separate.
biology_allocation: Replicate parity, ten of each per panel and allocation; report both separately as well as prespecified equal-weight averages
null: Independent biological patients; exposures independent of condition; no injected group confounding

generator.raw_counts: Poisson(exposure * latent biological abundance); integer observations retained
generator.membership: Random disjoint case indices, independent of baseline abundance. Save total perturbation and enriched-subset masks separately. Fixed affected fractions round to nearest patient.
generator.population_truth: Expected group arithmetic-mean ratio from the planted multipliers; wider and compensated-subset profiles have equal population means
generator.latent_truth: Realized patient abundances before count sampling; exact group areas and mean ratios on both scales

workflow.normalization: RLE fit on complete matrix; fit before test mask; references overlap tested genes; same RLE factors for all four WADE procedures and native DESeq2
workflow.permutation_stream: One recorded seed per matrix, identical across six statistic lanes and the separate public baseline replay
workflow.point_multiplicity: Each directional procedure has one BH family over 2G pairs; each unsigned procedure has G tests. Four procedures are separately evaluated, never merged by minimum q.
workflow.baseline_parity: Every dataset must reproduce the public unsigned log-W1 statistics, p-values, q-values, exceedances and stopping records. Abort on discrepancy.

native.DESeq2_settings: Native all-gene RLE independently verified against shared factors. Default DESeq fitting, Cook replacement/cutoffs and independent filtering; results at each prespecified alpha. Report replacement, p-value NA and independent-filter exclusions. No LFC shrinkage added.
native.edgeR_primary: TMM on common eligible counts, robust glmQLFit with legacy=FALSE and automatic NB dispersion; glmQLFTest and native BH
native.edgeR_sensitivity: Same QL pipeline with supplied RLE effective library sizes; separates normalization from testing
native.native_filter: Same pooled eligibility mask as WADE, followed by method-native inferential exclusions

endpoints.detection: Per-matrix TP FP TN FN, sensitivity, specificity, FDP and precision; eligible and all-gene denominators; distribution-change truth primary
endpoints.mean_target: Separately score mean-DE truth. A genuine distribution-only WADE discovery is not a false distribution call. Native methods primarily target means.
endpoints.direction: Gene-direction equality-null FDP plus unique-gene FDP; wrong-direction calls on ordered bulk profiles. No composite stochastic-order FDR guarantee.
endpoints.effects: Native log2FC and empirical normalized group-mean log2 ratios versus population and realized-latent truth; undefined ratios kept missing with coverage counts. Direction/scale do not change the empirical mean estimator. Area/curve errors use the matching linear/log latent targets; no conversion of area into fold change.
endpoints.patterns: Power by all 12 planted profiles and four abundance levels, including failures; shared tails are known distribution-null sentinels
endpoints.uncertainty: 95% intervals across independent matrices; paired bootstrap differences between methods, stratified by biology with fixed seeds. Complete-null any-call rates use exact binomial intervals. Never use genes as independent matrix replicates.
endpoints.performance_curves: Power and realized FDP at the five prespecified q thresholds. No post-hoc calibration of thresholds on the same matrices.
endpoints.scope: 120 independent full transcriptomes, 60 mixed and 60 null; repeated development evidence, not final FDR equivalence certification, established-real-data replication, or clinical accuracy

decision: Retain every method and failed pattern. Use this development run to select candidates and plan adequate fresh confirmation replication; do not promote a method based on sensitivity alone or certify FDR because a wide interval contains 5%. No production API change or figure approval follows automatically.
